title: An open letter on checking the machines
status: argument and appeal; not a research report with pinned third-party citations

claims.verification_scope: An honest null reported by the author. It is a bounded first-party benchmark result, not an external validation.

unpinned_references.text: The letter paraphrases a reviewer's recent observation that an AI-drafted paper had a real idea buried in it but was communicated too poorly to accept, and that acceptance is a human judgment no receipt can make. This paraphrase is presented as a general observation and is not pinned to a specific source in this edition.
